_about: Form-filling data for job applications (Workday and similar). Copy to applications/application-profile.json and fill it from Profile.md and your LinkedIn experience page. Use LinkedIn's month dates so forms match what recruiters can check. Descriptions must stay inside Profile.md's confirmed claims. Leave out the street address, passwords, and voluntary-disclosure answers: those stay with you. Workday rejects these characters in descriptions: < > [ ] " { } \

contact.address: You type the street address, city, and postal code yourself

standard_answers.former_employee_of_company: No, unless you say otherwise for this company
standard_answers.how_did_you_hear: The company's careers site (Workday: Career Websites > Corporate Website) unless a referral or recruiter applies
standard_answers.desired_salary: Leave blank when optional; if required, decide per role from the band in the package checklist

work_history.title: Staff Product Manager, Integrations
work_history.description:
- One line per confirmed achievement, copied from your resume
- No quotation marks or brackets
work_history.note: Newest first. Every entry needs a month: Workday turns a lone year into a wrong one

omitted_from_forms: Roles you deliberately leave off forms, with the reason

education.field_of_study: Leave blank if the form's list lacks it
